assign.request: When I respond on that page, the first few columns just disappear and hide… the usage meters disappear, which they shouldn't.

log.msg: Reproduced headless at 3440 and 1920, with the POSTs faked so nothing reached Servex. Nothing collapsed: sending (and typing) scrolled the card page down to the chat box, at the bottom of the tallest column, and usage and running now went off the top.

decision.msg: On the Live card only, the chat box sits above the chat and the newest line comes first (CSS order + column-reverse), so the box is near the top at every width and replying never scrolls. Alternatives rejected: a sticky chat column (an inner scroller, which the owner refused), or capping the chat to the last N lines (the box still sits at the bottom of a tall column).

assign.outcome:
**Replying on the Live card no longer scrolls usage and running now away** — merged into michael/dev (branch worktree/live-reply, merge commit 2cbe3493).

- What was happening: the chat box sat at the bottom of the longest column, so typing or sending scrolled the whole card down to it.
- The fix: on the [Live card](/framework/ai2/live/) the box now sits above the chat and the newest line comes first. Other cards are unchanged.
